domain: Field and device integration B: RF receive and simulation, firmware analysis of owned equipment, device access (hand-verified 2026-10-08 against archlinux.org and the AUR after the agent sweep for this domain was blocked by the API safeguard)
notes: All rows here are Arch or AUR packages checked by name on 2026-10-08; licence strings are the package metadata. Every GPL tool runs as a separate process or container, never linked into aces-* code. Policy from VISION.md section 5b applies: receive-only RF and read-only device sessions in v1, transmit and writes behind approvals, firmware analysis only on images from the project's own or authorised equipment, inside a network-less container. Note: the Arch package named `cutter` is an unrelated firewall tool; the rizin GUI (Cutter) is not in the Arch repositories under that name.
